title: DDF project profile (.ddf/project.yaml)
description: Per-project policy, always read from the integration branch. Keys follow spec section 6.7; policy only tightens across layers (section 3).

autonomy.description: Requested level; effective = min(operator maximum, this). Default propose.

required.description: Forge check names the merge gate requires; at least one name. Omit the key to mean: at least one check run, all successful.

image.description: Optional container build file; default base image otherwise.

registries.description: Registry host names (no scheme, path or port) a verify that installs at run time needs. They join the egress allow-list of this project's Executor, local-gate and forge-local CI containers, enforced from M3. Project dependencies come from the project image by default. Default none.

ciEntrypoints.description: Scripts and manifests CI relies on; force the sensitive class.

forbidden.description: Additional forbidden path globs on top of the product defaults.

hardStops.description: Hard-stop categories, e.g. secrets, deploy, real-money, data-destructive. Projects may add categories.

r2DifferentProvider.description: Require R2 on a different provider than the Executor: R2 uses only routing entries whose provider differs from the provider of the entry that ran the Executor for the reviewed head. Adapter and model are not compared.
